people.imagined: Midnight in a fever town, but she is laughing. She sits on an upturned barrel between two cots with the gourd on her hip, needle roll open on her knee, one needle pinched in her fingers, telling the patient a very bad joke.
people.subject: The moment: at midnight on an upturned barrel in a lantern-lit sickroom, a silver needle held up between two fingers, she is laughing so hard her eyes have vanished. Face: a round, soft, rosy old face of seventy-two with big cheeks, deep laugh lines, a small plump nose, a wide laughing mouth with a few gaps in the teeth, a faint wine flush across nose and cheeks. Hair: thick white hair piled into a high loose bun, a whole cluster of fresh pink plum blossoms pinned in it beside a long jade hairpin. Body: short, round and comfortable, shoulders shaking. Clothing: as head of her house she wears the richest version of the sect's dress: three layers of fine spring-green silk with crossed collars embroidered in silver with healing herbs and wine cups, a pale jade-green gauze over-robe with wide drifting sleeves, a white silk sash hung with a jade pendant and tassel, a small jade crown among the blossoms; a white gourd hangs at her right hip. Hands and objects: the right hand pinches a long silver needle with a boxwood handle up to the light; on her knee the left holds open a roll of green silk with eight more needles in neat slots. Power: a soft green-and-blue aura of spring water and young leaves round her shoulders, a few green motes and fine droplets drifting up around the needle. Background: dim blurred cots with a sleeper, mist, faint motes of light. Light: warm lantern light from the lower left on her cheeks and the blossoms, a cool spirit-glow rim along her sleeves. Expression: roaring, merry, tireless kindness.

people.imagined: In the cold cellar between rows of sealed jars. He is holding the little half-spring, half-lake cask in both hands against his apron and speaking quietly to someone just out of sight, not quite meeting their eye.
people.subject: The moment: deep in a cold cellar of sealed jars, he holds a small cask in both hands against his chest and speaks softly to someone just out of sight, eyes not quite meeting theirs. Face: a heavy soft face of fifty with a double chin, pale skin with a cellar's grey chill, soft thick brows, small pale careful brown eyes that rarely settle, a broad flat nose, a small mild smile, close-trimmed grey stubble. Hair: thinning grey hair combed flat under a small jade crown. Body: big, heavy, wide-shouldered and soft, weight leaning back. Clothing: as an elder he wears the sect's richer dress: a pale jade-green gauze over-robe over two layers of green silk, crossed collars embroidered in silver with wine cups, wide sleeves, a white silk sash; round his neck on a silk cord hangs a heavy square seal of grey stone with no writing, resting on his chest. Hands and objects: both soft, clean-knuckled hands cradle a small travelling cask of dark wood with silver hoops. Power: a cool blue-green chill gathers round him, thin mist curling off his sleeves and a few pale droplets hanging in the air. Background: rows of tall clay jars sealed with red clay stoppers fading into darkness, drifting mist. Light: dim amber lantern light from the upper left, cold blue moonlike shadow in the corners and a faint spirit-glow on the seal. Expression: mild, reasonable, hiding a calculation.

people.imagined: The grey dawn on a road leading out of the lake country. She stands half-packed, her pack open at her feet, her sleeves cuffed and stained dark green, deciding what to leave behind for the next fever.
people.subject: The moment: at grey dawn on a lakeside road she crouches over an open pack, one hand stuffing in a bundle of herbs, glaring up fiercely at someone out of frame. Face: a thin, lean, sun-browned face of forty-two with sharp cheekbones, level dark brows drawn together, sharp impatient honest dark eyes, a narrow straight nose, a firm mouth with the corner pulled down, a faint scratch on the jaw. Hair: black, cropped to the ear and rough as if cut with a knife, a single plain jade pin at one temple. Body: thin, wiry and tall, lean forearms, weight forward on the balls of her feet. Clothing: the sect's fine spring-green silk in a short travelling cut with crossed collars, tied up at the hip, a white silk sash worn tight with a silver-embroidered herb border at the hem; the wide cuffs of both sleeves heavily stained dark green with herb juice, big and visible; silver-grey silk gaiters laced to the knee. Hands and objects: the right hand packs dried herb bundles into a travelling pack, nails green at the tips; at the left wrist hangs a roll of needles in green silk. Power: a faint fresh-green aura, a few motes of leaf-light drifting up from the herb bundles. Background: a pale misty road, a lantern on the ground, low marsh reeds, thin mist over a ditch. Light: cold silver dawn light from the upper left, a green spirit-glow round the herbs, soft rim light on her cropped hair. Expression: an urgent, stern glare upward, brows hard together, the corner of the mouth dragged down.

people.imagined: In the tasting room, in the instant before a cask is opened. Her head has already turned toward it though the lid is shut and no one has spoken. Her milky eyes stare past it. Her husband stands rigidly behind her.
people.subject: The moment: seated very still at a tasting table in a stone room, her face turned precisely toward a closed cask, eyes wide open and blind. Face: a long, pale, still face of forty-two with fine bones, both eyes entirely milky white without pupils, wide and unblinking, the first and biggest detail; thin dark brows, a narrow straight nose with flared nostrils, thin lips in a faint knowing smile, a small scar at the left cheekbone. Hair: black, drawn severely back into a tight low knot held by a plain white jade pin. Body: slender and upright, stillness without wasted motion, head slightly tilted. Clothing: three layers of dark spring-green silk with high crossed collars embroidered in silver with wine cups, long narrow sleeves with silver cloud borders, a white silk sash with a jade pendant, a thin white taster's cloth tucked in the left cuff. Hands and objects: the long pale fingers of the right hand rest flat on a round cask lid; the left holds a small white porcelain tasting cup, empty, at chest height. Power: a thin blue-green water haze lies about her shoulders, tiny droplets drifting. Background: a stone tasting room, racks of dark bottles, the blurred shoulder of a man in a dark robe, drifting mist. Light: soft amber lamp light from the upper left, her white eyes catching two small spirit-bright highlights, a cool blue rim along her cheek. Expression: composed, listening with the whole face, a faint smile that gives nothing away.

people.imagined: Night at the cart yard. He is cracking his whip with his rough right hand while the left holds a lantern up as softly as a merchant, hurrying the carters out onto the lake road with a cheerful word.
people.subject: The moment: at night in a cart yard, he coils a whip in his right hand and raises a paper lantern in his left, calling a cheerful word to carters hurrying onto the lake road. Face: a good-natured, round, clean-shaven face of thirty-six with warm brown eyes crinkled by an easy smile, soft brows, a short nose, a friendly mouth parted mid-call, a boyish dimple. Hair: black, tied loosely with a green silk cord and a small jade bead, a strand across the forehead. Body: medium height, strong shoulders from lifting barrels, chest open, weight on the front foot. Clothing: fine green silk in a high-collared jacket with crossed collars, silver-embroidered wine-cup borders, a white silk sash knotted twice with a jade pendant, a brown silk working over-skirt tied at the waist, clean and graceful; a letter packet tucked in the front. Hands and objects: the right palm is dark, hard and calloused around a coiled whip; the left hand is soft, pale and unmarked, lifting a paper lantern. Power: a faint water-blue gleam on his hands and on the barrels behind. Background: a wet courtyard, a line of covered carts, steaming mules, a black road to the lake under a thin pale moon, drifting mist. Light: warm lantern light from the upper left, cool moonlight rim on his hair. Expression: an easy, trusting, hurried grin, eyes crinkled and quick, feet already moving.

people.imagined: In the herb meadows, a carter at the gate and a refusal in progress. He stands with arms crossed, his one clouded eye turned slightly aside and the good eye fixed hard, a crushed mint sprig stuck behind his ear.
people.subject: The moment: standing at a meadow gate with his arms crossed, glaring down at someone out of frame in a refusal, one eye clouded white. Face: a lean, hard, long face of forty-five tanned like leather; the right eye entirely clouded white and blank, the first mark; the left eye dark and fierce; shaggy grey-streaked brows, a hooked nose, a thin turned-down mouth, a short rough pepper-grey beard. Hair: grey-black, tied up with a twist of green silk, a crushed green mint sprig tucked behind the right ear. Body: tall and lean, narrow-shouldered, feet planted a little too far apart like a gate himself. Clothing: sect spring-green silk with crossed collars and silver herb embroidery, plain but graceful, a white silk sash, wide sleeves rolled to the elbow, the hems soiled at the knees; a broad straw hat hangs at his back on a silk cord. Hands and objects: arms crossed over his chest; the right hand tucked under the left elbow holds a small iron herb knife with a short wooden handle; knuckles cracked and earth-stained. Power: a faint green glow gathers in the shadows near the crushed mint, a few leaf-green motes. Background: strips of herb meadow, a wooden gate, a blurred loaded cart, low hills in morning mist. Light: bright cool silvery daylight from the upper left with soft rim light. Expression: a stubborn, offended glare, the clouded eye blank and the dark eye fierce, as if the visitor had insulted his meadow.

people.imagined: A fever town at night. She is carrying a small child on her back in a green sash-sling and looking over her shoulder at the child's face, her forearm with the burned brand showing under the lamp.
people.subject: The moment: in a fever town at night, a sleeping child carried on her back in a green silk sash-sling, her head turned to look at the small face over her shoulder. Face: a young, tired, gentle face of twenty-eight, pale brown skin, dark shadows under kind dark eyes, soft dark brows lifted, a small straight nose, soft pressed lips, a strand of damp hair on the cheek. Hair: black, in a long loose braid over one shoulder, a white silk ribbon at its end. Body: slim and steady, leaning forward under the load. Clothing: simple graceful spring-green silk in a travelling cut with two crossed collars, silver herb borders, the sleeves pushed up, a white silk sash wound round to hold the child; a small needle roll in green silk at the wrist. Hands and objects: the bare right forearm shows a burned brand, a ring of small vertical bars like barrel staves, drawn clearly; the left hand supports the child's small bare foot. Power: a soft green freshness round her hands, a few motes of leaf-light over the child's sleeping face. Background: rows of dark shuttered houses, one yellow lamp at a corner, a pale rope of fog drifting along the street. Light: warm lamp light from the upper right on her face and arm, the street in cold blue moonlit shade, soft rim light on the child's cheek. Expression: a tired, tender look, all her attention on the small sleeping face.

people.imagined: Dawn in the cellar. He is slumped against a vat with a hiccup mid-hiccup, a jar in his lap, still wearing last night's smile, blaming the mash to the empty room.
people.subject: The moment: at dawn in a huge dim cellar, slumped against a wine vat mid-hiccup, one hand lifted to his mouth, a small jar in his lap, still wearing last night's smile. Face: a round flushed face of twenty-two, shiny cheeks and a nose red as a plum, sleepy half-closed eyes, thin messy brows, a snub nose, a loose silly grin, a smear of grain mash on the chin. Hair: brown and tousled, a bit of grain stuck above the ear, a green hair ribbon askew. Body: soft, short, round-bellied, sprawled with his legs out. Clothing: sect green silk, rumpled, with crossed collars buttoned wrong by one button, silver wine-cup embroidery on the border, a white silk sash loosened and trailing, an amber silk brewer's over-vest slipped to one side; bare feet, one sock with a hole. Hands and objects: the right hand covers his mouth in the hiccup; the left cradles a small stoppered clay jar against his chest like a toy, its stopper hanging loose. Power: none beyond a very faint blue-green haze of wine-breath over the jar. Background: oak vats taller than a man, strings of pale sprouted grain, broken clay shards in the corner, drifting mist. Light: a stripe of cold silver dawn light from a high window across his feet, warm lamp bounce on his face. Expression: a sleepy, slyly pleased smile, heavy lids half down, a hiccup trembling behind the hand.

people.imagined: On the stone steps of the Dawn Hall at dusk. She sits with her cracked hands open on her knees, the white salt seams along every finger plain in the light, looking out over the lake and wishing for more Wood.
people.subject: The moment: at dusk on the stone steps of a lakeside hall, she sits with both hands open palm-up on her knees, looking down at the white-seamed fingers. Face: a thin, pale, frail face of twenty with a sea-wind pink at the cheekbones, large dark patient eyes with grey shadows beneath, thin soft brows, a small nose, a small mouth with a faint hopeful curve. Hair: long brown hair tied low with a plain white silk cord, a few strands lifting in the lake wind. Body: slender, narrow-shouldered, a little hollow-chested, knees together, head bowed so the thin neck shows. Clothing: the sect's simplest graceful spring-green silk, neat and clean, two crossed collars, silver herb borders at the cuffs, a white silk sash in a small precise bow. Hands and objects: both hands lie open on her knees, every finger cracked and dry with a thin white line of salt along every cuticle, the clear focus of the picture; the needle roll in her lap is tied with a green ribbon. Power: a faint pale-blue wash round her, a few water-bright motes rising from her palms. Background: the lake pale and flat to a line of reeds, a small boat with a lantern far out, a heron in the shallows, stone steps descending to the water, early stars. Light: pink dusk light from the upper left, a moonlit rim along her hair. Expression: quiet, wistful, hopeful, a girl making the best of a hard gift.

people.imagined: In the herb garden's little record shed. He is at the desk, chewing the corner of a blank page with a calendar spread open, looking up at the ceiling trying to guess.
people.subject: The moment: in a little garden record shed he sits at a desk chewing the corner of a blank page, a calendar open, eyes turned up to the ceiling as he tries to guess. Face: a long, soft, careful face of twenty-four, light brown skin, mild honest brown eyes cast up, thin brows, a long nose, the lower lip pulled in around a corner of paper, a dot of ink on the cheek and a pale ink smudge on the right ear. Hair: brown, shaggy over the ears, a quill-like twig stuck in it, a green silk tie slipping. Body: lanky, narrow-shouldered, hunched forward, Adam's apple showing as his neck cranes back. Clothing: sect spring-green silk with two crossed collars, a stain of crushed leaf on the front, silver herb borders, a white silk sash tied crooked, sleeves pushed up; a small silk pouch of pressed flowers at his side. Hands and objects: the right hand holds a brush above the table; the left holds the paper corner at his mouth; the desk is covered with columns of tiny drawings of flowers, no writing. Power: none, only a faint green freshness in the air. Background: dried herb bunches hanging from beams, small clay pots on a shelf, an open window onto green beds, a half-eaten rice cake, a tabby cat asleep on a stool. Light: soft silvery side light from the upper left with a gentle glow on the window. Expression: dreamy, uncertain, guilty.

people.imagined: The road north in spring with the Pivot's jars. He walks under the carrying-yoke with a jar hung at each end, the left shoulder visibly lower and wider, whistling.
people.subject: The moment: walking a spring road under a heavy carrying yoke with a big clay jar hung at each end, whistling. Face: a broad, kindly, weathered face of thirty-eight, thick black brows, calm small brown eyes, a flat nose, a wide mouth pursed in a quiet whistle, a day's stubble. Hair: black, cropped, a green silk band round the forehead. Body: stocky and enormously strong, the right shoulder dropped a hand lower than the left and the left a hand wider and thicker, the asymmetry plain under the tunic; a long rolling stride, head up. Clothing: as a servant of the house he is plainer but clean: a tunic of good brown silk-cotton with a crossed collar over green leggings tied at the knee, a green armband with a small silver herb on the left sleeve, a padded pad across the left shoulder where the yoke rests, a white sash, a bamboo flask at his belt. Hands and objects: both hands hold the yoke ropes; the two sealed clay jars are unmarked. Power: none, only a faint earthy brown-red glow along the yoke. Background: a spring road between flooded paddies mirroring the sky, a line of small figures far ahead, white egrets lifting off a dyke, pink peach blossom, soft cream clouds and a light mist. Light: clear luminous morning light from the upper left with a soft golden rim. Expression: steady and proud, the small eyes fixed on the road, a quiet whistle on his lips.

people.imagined: Remembered: the founder at her sweet spring in 660, kneeling to taste the water from her cupped hands, the first discovery of the wine.
people.subject: The moment: a memorial portrait of the founder at forty-five, kneeling at her sweet spring in the year 660, raising water in her cupped hands at the first discovery of the wine. Face: a quiet, patient, plain face, skin brown from the paddies, calm dark eyes wide with attention, level thick brows, a short straight nose, a soft mouth in a tiny wondering smile. Hair: black, in a plain bun under a wide straw hat tipped back on her neck, a single white flower in the bun. Body: sturdy, slim, bent forward from the waist on both knees, bare brown feet sunk in damp earth. Clothing: the founder's robe, simple but graceful: layered green silk with crossed collars, a white silk sash, the wide sleeves tied back with cloth strips and wet to the elbow, the skirt kilted to the knee and muddy at the hem, a faint silver embroidery of herb leaves on the border. Hands and objects: both hands lifted and cupped, clear water falling in drops; a bamboo ladle and a small clay pot with green leaves floating in water beside her. Power: a soft green-and-blue glow in the water in her hands, a few motes of spring-light rising from it. Background: the spring wells from a pool ringed with grey stones, rushes and yellow iris, paddies beyond with a single egret, silver mist lifting. Light: soft spirit-light from the water glinting on her face. The whole picture faded and yellowed like old silk, edges darkened. Expression: gentle, absorbed, the soft mouth almost smiling.

people.imagined: Remembered: the healer at the gate of Cựu Khê, stepping into the sick town alone before anyone else dared, a cloth over his mouth, looking straight at the street.
people.subject: The moment: a memorial portrait of a healer of forty-eight stepping alone into the street of a plague town before anyone else dared, a white cloth tied over his nose and mouth, eyes fixed ahead. Face: a lean, earnest, brown face, the lower half under the cloth, bright intense dark eyes under heavy straight brows set in a frown, a high forehead with a bead of sweat. Hair: black, in a rough topknot bound with a strip of green silk. Body: tall, thin and straight, striding, one foot lifted, shoulders square, chin up. Clothing: a healer's robe of spring-green silk with crossed collars and silver herb borders, wet with sweat at the neck, tied up at the knees, the sleeves tied back with cords, the long coat tails flying; a white silk sash with a roll of needles in green silk and a small gourd of wine at the belt. Hands and objects: the right hand holds a lit lantern; the left carries a bundle of herbs tied with cord. Power: a pale green glow around the lantern and herbs, a few leaf-green motes streaming behind him. Background: a narrow empty street of shuttered doors each marked with a chalk cross, an abandoned handcart, a heavy low grey sky, a thin line of smoke far off. Light: pale silver light from the upper left, the lantern's soft glow on his face. The whole picture faded and yellowed like old silk, edges darkened. Expression: a set, unafraid stare under a hard frown.

people.imagined: On the shore at night, waiting for a boat that has not come. She has a sick man on her back and a stoop from years of it, shifting the weight and glaring across the black water.
people.subject: The moment: standing at night on a lake shore with a sick man's arms hanging over her shoulders, glaring across the black water for a boat that has not come. Face: a strong, kind, plain face of forty, sun-browned, firm straight brows pulled together, sharp tired dark eyes, a wide nose, a set mouth, a bead of sweat at the temple. Hair: black, wrapped tight in a green silk kerchief. Body: sturdy, bent forward at the shoulders in a deep old stoop from years of carrying, knees bent, feet wide, the patient's head lolling against her neck and his bare feet dangling near her knees. Clothing: spring-green silk in a travelling cut with two crossed collars and silver herb borders, tucked up with a cord at the hip, a white silk sash wound tight, strong boots; a small wooden needle-shaped amulet on a thong; forearms strong and tendoned. Hands and objects: both hands hold the limp wrists across her chest; a gold-coloured needle case hangs at her belt. Power: a faint green glow runs along her hands and the sick man's wrists, a few leaf-green motes. Background: black pebble shore and wet sand, tangled reeds, a boat's lantern far across the water, a small fire on the bank where a blanket and pack lie ready, thin mist. Light: pale moonlight from the upper left laying a silver road on the lake, a green spirit-glow at her hands. Expression: stern, tired, unshakable under the load.

people.imagined: At the Spring House door at dawn. He has checked the latch twice, and now bends to check the clay seal on a jar for the third time while a gauge hangs from his belt.
people.subject: The moment: at the Spring House door at dawn, bent close over a clay jar with his thumb pressing its seal for the third time, the other hand still on the latch behind him. Face: a narrow, neat, anxious face of forty-two, pale skin, small careful eyes with dark rings, thin tidy brows, a thin nose, a small tight mouth, a thin moustache trimmed to a line. Hair: black, combed flat and tied neatly under a plain cap of green silk. Body: thin, neat and a little stooped, shoulders hunched, elbows tucked, weight on the left foot as if about to step away. Clothing: a fine green silk jacket buttoned to the throat with two crossed collars, silver wine-cup borders, a clean amber silk steward's over-robe with narrow sleeves, a white silk sash in a double knot; a round brass gauge on a silk cord at his hip, its small face carrying a single needle. Hands and objects: the right thumb presses a red clay seal on a jar; the left hand grips a heavy iron latch, knuckles white. Power: a faint water-blue tint gathers round the jars, one or two cool motes. Background: a heavy iron-bound oak door in cold grey stone, racks of clay jars with red stoppers, a lantern burnt low, the first pale strip of dawn at the end of the passage, mist. Light: cold grey-blue dawn light from the upper left, soft rim light on his cap. Expression: anxious, shifty, the small ringed eyes sliding to the door behind him.

people.imagined: A night road with a cart. He has a scarf wound twice across his mouth against the lake damp, and only his eyes show, flicking sideways to count who is behind him.
people.subject: The moment: sitting on a cart at night with a thick scarf wound twice across his lower face, only his eyes showing, sliding sideways to count who is behind him. Face: only the upper face is visible: narrow shifty dark eyes, one brow higher than the other, deep lines at the eye corners, the bridge of a long nose; below, a grey scarf wound twice round the mouth and chin, the largest feature. Hair: black, under a wide flat cap with a green silk band. Body: wiry and hunched on the cart seat, shoulders forward, elbows on knees, head turned so eyes and scarf face the viewer while the rest of him points down the road. Clothing: as a hand of the house he is plainer but clean: a brown silk-cotton tunic with a crossed collar and a green armband with a small silver herb, a buttoned dark vest, a white sash, sandals tied with cloth strips; a cord of knots, one for each trip, hangs round his neck. Hands and objects: both hands hold the reins loosely. Power: none, only a faint grey-blue damp mist clinging to the scarf. Background: a pale lake road under a heavy dark sky, a cart piled with wet barrels under tarred canvas, a mule's head in blur, a lantern ahead and another far behind, cold mist on the black water. Light: dim yellow lantern light from the lower right, a faint cold moonlit rim on his cap. Expression: watchful, calculating over the scarf, one brow lifted.

people.imagined: At the meadow graves, a drover's widow has just left. She humbly hums to the herbs as she presses seed into a fresh grave, perfectly calm, bent over, while the widow's shadow is still on the path.
people.subject: The moment: kneeling on a fresh mound in a meadow of graves, pressing seeds into the soil with her fingers and humming, while a drover's widow's shadow is still on the path. Face: a round, calm, pleasant face of twenty-two, pale brown skin, half-closed placid dark eyes cast down, soft round brows, a small nose, a soft closed mouth humming, a streak of earth on the cheek. Hair: brown, in two loose braids tied with green silk, a sprig of herb behind the ear. Body: sturdy and round-shouldered, kneeling with her weight back on her heels, round face tilted down. Clothing: sect spring-green silk with two crossed collars and silver herb borders, earth-streaked at the knees, a white silk sash, a pale herb-cloth over-skirt, sleeves rolled to the elbow; a small silk bag of seed at her waist. Hands and objects: each thumb presses a single tiny seed into dark earth with perfect calm; a folded white herb cloth lies beside her. Power: a very faint fresh-green glow in the earth under her fingers, tiny motes rising as sprouts. Background: a wide green meadow of low mounds in careful rows, each with a line of new sprouts and herbs in white cloth at its head, a pale gravel path, far off a widow in dark clothes walking away head down, soft mist. Light: gentle luminous afternoon light from the upper left, a green rim glow on her hair. Expression: serene, untroubled, a little too calm.

people.imagined: In the tasting room with her mistress behind her. She sticks out her tongue slightly, deep blue, to test the air of a cup, then covers it with a perfectly composed face.
people.subject: The moment: tasting at a table in a cool dim room, the tip of her tongue just showing, stained deep blue, the face above it perfectly composed, her mistress standing behind her. Face: a smooth, composed, pretty face of twenty with sea-brown skin, calm cool dark eyes, neat even brows, a small straight nose, lips slightly parted so the blue tongue shows to the tip, big and plain; a pale slender neck. Hair: long black hair braided and coiled at the nape with a white shell pin and a silver hairpin. Body: slim and upright, elbows in, neck straight. Clothing: the sect's simplest graceful spring-green silk, high crossed collars fastened by a small silver clasp, silver wine-cup borders, a white silk sash in a flat bow, a folded white taster's cloth over her left shoulder. Hands and objects: both hands hold a small porcelain tasting cup loosely at her chest; before her a tray of seven small white cups in a row. Power: a faint blue-green water haze at the cup's rim, a few droplet-bright motes. Background: a stone-walled tasting room, racks of dark bottles, one small window of pale light, a brazier with a curl of smoke, the blurred shoulder of a tall still woman in dark green behind her, face turned away. Light: soft amber lamp light from the upper left, cool blue rim light along her neck. Expression: serene, perfectly cool, concealing everything behind the blue tongue.

people.imagined: At dawn at the oar of the Dawn Hall's boat, a white nick through his eyebrow, rowing hard across the grey lake, looking back at the shore with a sly smile as he counts the silver in his sleeve.
people.subject: The moment: at dawn at the oar of the Dawn Hall's boat, rowing hard across the grey lake, looking back at the shore with a sly smile, a heavy sleeve sagging with silver. Face: a lean, sharp, sun-darkened face of thirty, the left eyebrow split by a clean white scar, plain and prominent; bright shrewd eyes, a long nose, a broad grin with a gold tooth, stubble. Hair: black, tied with a blue silk rag and a small jade bead. Body: lean, broad-chested, strong forearms, leaning back into the stroke, feet braced, arms straight. Clothing: sect spring-green silk in a boatman's cut with two crossed collars, silver herb borders, sleeves rolled to the shoulder showing sinew, a white silk sash tied in front, a silver coin sewn into the cuff and a small heavy bag weighing one sleeve down; bare brown feet. Hands and objects: both hands grip a long wooden oar. Power: a faint water-blue gleam on the oar and the barrels, a few droplet motes lifting from the wake. Background: a wide pewter lake with a thin line of pink at the horizon, a long white V of wake, two barrels in the stern under a net, the pale stone landing far behind with a small waving figure, mist. Light: cool pink dawn light from the upper left, a silver spirit-glow on the water. Expression: a cheerful, shifty grin tipped to one side, eyes sliding to check who is watching.

people.imagined: Stirring a big vat with a long paddle. He has tasted something and is carefully, slowly holding the paddle still, his pink-scalded tongue-tip between his lips, trying to decide who to tell.
people.subject: The moment: standing beside a big steaming vat with a long wooden paddle held still, the pink scalded tongue-tip between his lips as he decides who to tell what he tasted. Face: a broad, honest, slow face of nineteen, wide-set round brown eyes, thick brows lifted, a snub nose, the pink scalded tongue-tip showing plainly. Hair: brown, cropped, steam-damp. Body: big and soft-shouldered, paddle upright like a staff, shoulders hunched, chin lowered. Clothing: the sect's simplest graceful silk: an amber brewer's silk jacket with two crossed collars and silver wine-cup borders, darkened with wet at the hem, a white silk sash, sleeves pushed up above forearms red from steam, a bit of white foam on his wrist. Hands and objects: both big hands wrap a long wooden paddle; steam rises from a huge dark vat. Power: a faint blue-green haze of spirit-warmed steam round him, a few droplet motes. Background: a brewing hall with oak vats the height of a house, rafters lost in steam, a high window letting down a column of pale light, a boy carrying a pail in blur, a ladder hung over the nearest vat's rim. Light: warm hazy steam light from the upper left, a soft silver spirit-glow from the window. Expression: a puzzled, worried, slow frown, the wide eyes lifted as he works something out.
